title: The database retains the previous snapshot and reports staleness by digest
summary: A database reader now keeps the previous per-record digests across a refresh that changed a source (a refresh with no change keeps them), and reports staleness(identity) as unchanged, changed, new or removed and readiness(identity, subjectRevision) as current, previous or unknown; open(root, {previous}) seeds them in a later process. A new capture store keeps the current and previous captured snapshots ({format: 'ia-snapshot-1', revision, membership}) under .ia/work/snapshot, independent of the graph cache and readable with the cache disabled: captureOf, writeCaptured (rotating current to previous only when the revision changes), readCaptured, readCapturedSnapshot and digestIndex. The store writes a .gitignore into its own directory when it has none. New operational code IA-DB-SNAPSHOT-UNAVAILABLE.
